info.title: HiringPizza Workforce API
info.description: Workflow-first API for workforce management. Employee operations are store-scoped by store number. Global catalog endpoints are not store-scoped.

tags.name: Employee Shirt Milestones
tags.description: Every completed month of tenure earns an employee a branded shirt. A nightly job opens a milestone and notifies the store manager, who fills in the shirt details; a fulfilment role then orders it and marks it delivered.

tags.name: Shirt Catalog
tags.description: The colours, logos and shirt templates the entry form and its live preview are built from.

post.description: Initiates a separation workflow. Employee status only changes upon decision approval. Store-scoped: employee must be assigned to this store.

post.summary: Approve or reject a separation request
post.description: Records decision on separation request. When decision='completed', employee status automatically updates to terminated/resigned and status history is recorded.

post.summary: Create hiring request with position details and optional candidates
post.description: Initiates hiring workflow for one or more positions. Position count must equal employees_needed minus candidate count. Store-scoped.

get.summary: Manager dashboard snapshot for a store on a given date
get.description: Returns all active employees assigned to the store with: upcoming birthday flags (within 7 days of `date`), current position, current base/performance pay, and their performance metric value for column id 3 within the week (Tuesday–Monday) that contains `date`.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Reference date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Determines the 7-day birthday window and the Tuesday–Monday metric week.

post.summary: Complete hiring request by recording hired employees
post.description: Records which employees were hired. All employee IDs must exist and count must match number_hired.

get.description:
Returns the same four dashboard sections as the single-store reports endpoint (`manager-dashboard`, `high-hours-employees`, `average-hourly-pay`, `weekly-labor`) but for multiple stores over an explicit date range in a single call.

**Store selection:** Pass `stores[]=101&stores[]=102` for specific stores, or `stores[]=all` to include every store.

**Date range:** `start_date` and `end_date` are used directly as metric window boundaries (inclusive). Weekly-labor entries are bucketed into Tuesday–Monday business weeks within the range.

**Full details:** The `average-hourly-pay` section returns one row per employee (pay, hours, tips, labor) rather than store-level aggregates. All other sections match the single-store equivalents.

The response is a plain object keyed by store number.

parameters.name: stores[]
parameters.description: One or more store numbers, e.g. `stores[]=101&stores[]=102`. Pass `stores[]=all` to include every store.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Range start date (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive).

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Range end date (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive). Must be on or after start_date.

200.description: Report data keyed by store number

422.description: Validation error — missing or invalid parameters

post.summary: Create and fill a shirt milestone in one call
post.description: For giving someone a shirt without waiting for a month to come around. Creates the milestone already `submitted`, so it lands straight in the fulfilment queue. Manual milestones carry a null `milestone_month`, so any number of them can coexist for one employee.

404.description: Store not found, or employee not assigned to this store

422.description: Validation error. Includes the case where the employee has no shirt size on file and none was supplied.

404.description: Not found, or the milestone belongs to another store

post.summary: Fill in the shirt details (pending_entry -> submitted)
post.description: The store manager's form: colour, logo, and the employee's shirt size. The size is mandatory when the profile has none, and whatever is entered is saved onto the employee's profile. Gender is taken from the profile automatically.

200.description: Entry recorded; the milestone is now `submitted`

404.description: Not found, or the milestone belongs to another store

422.description: Validation error, including a missing mandatory t_shirt_size

positions.description: If an item has `id`, it updates that row. If `id` is omitted, a new row is created.

marital_statuses.description: If an item has `id`, it updates that row. If `id` is omitted, a new row is created.

id_types.description: If an item has `id`, it updates that row. If `id` is omitted, a new row is created.

attachment_types.description: If an item has `id`, it updates that row. If `id` is omitted, a new row is created.

tag_ids.description: Attachment tags to sync for this attachment type

tags.description: If an item has `id`, it updates that row. If `id` is omitted, a new row is created.

image.description: Image file upload for obsession profile photo. The server stores the file and persists its path in image_path.

id_type_id.description: ID type used to match the CSV ID column. Defaults to 1 when omitted.

WorkflowRequestStatus.description: For separation requests: pending | rejected | completed. For hiring requests: pending | completed.

WorkflowRequestTypePage.description: A standard Laravel length-aware paginator page, scoped to a single request type.

WorkflowRequestIndexResponse.description: Workflow requests grouped by type. Each group is paginated independently via `{type}_page`/`{type}_per_page` query params, so paging one tab never shifts the data shown in another. A group is present only when its type wasn't excluded by `request_type`/`request_types[]`.

attachments.description: Proof files for the separation request

positions.description: Position details. Count must equal employees_needed - candidate count

employee_ids.description: IDs of employees to hire (must exist)

oneOf.description: Birthday falls within the next 7 days of the reference date.
No birthday within the next 7 days.

ManagerDashboardMetric.description: Performance metric value for column id 3 within the Tuesday–Monday week containing the reference date.

position.description: Label of the employee's latest effective position.

base_pay.description: Latest effective base pay formatted to 2 decimal places.

performance_pay.description: Latest effective performance pay formatted to 2 decimal places.

metric.description: Metric for column id 3 within the week. Null if none recorded.

date.description: The reference date passed in the path.

week_start.description: Tuesday that starts the week containing `date`.

week_end.description: Monday that ends the week containing `date`.

metrics.description: All metric rows within the requested date range (columns 2, 3, 10, 31).

total_hours.description: Column id 3 — total hours for the period.

employees.description: Employees with ≥ 60 total hours (column id 3) in the period.

MultiStoreReportPayEmployee.description: Per-employee pay detail for the requested date range. Each field reflects the MAX value recorded across all metric rows for that employee in the period.

employees.description: One row per employee — full detail, not aggregated.

labor.description: Average labor % × 100 for this week. Null if no data.

entries.description: One entry per Tuesday–Monday week that overlaps the requested date range.

MultiStoreReportsResponse.description: Object keyed by store number. Each value is a MultiStoreReportEntry.

ShirtMilestoneStatus.description: pending_entry -> submitted -> ordered -> delivered. Anything not yet delivered can be cancelled.

ShirtMilestoneSource.description: `automatic` was opened by the nightly tenure job; `manual` was raised by a store without waiting for a month to come around.

ShirtPrintArea.description: Where the logo sits on the shirt, in the template SVG's own viewBox coordinates. Convert to percentages once against the viewBox and the preview scales at any size.

mime_type.description: image/svg+xml or image/png. Render either with a plain .

gender.description: null means the template is unisex.

svg_url.description: Fetch and INLINE this SVG so it can be recoloured. Recolourable paths use fill="currentColor", so setting CSS `color` on a wrapper tints the whole shirt. Every uploaded SVG is sanitized server-side.

ShirtCatalog.description: Everything the preview UI needs to bootstrap, in one call. Active rows only.

milestone_month.description: Which month of the current stint this shirt is for. null for manual entries.

stint_start_date.description: Effective date of the latest hired/rehired status. null for manual entries.

t_shirt_size.description: Snapshot of the size at entry time; the profile may change later.

shirt_color_id.description: Must be an active shirt colour.

shirt_template_id.description: Omit to let the API pick by the employee's gender.

t_shirt_size.description: REQUIRED when the employee has no size on file — the response is a 422 naming t_shirt_size if you omit it. Whatever you send is also saved onto the employee's profile.

total_delivered.description: How many shirts this employee has actually received.

by_status.description: Count per status; every status key is always present.
